This looks like a CBP ruling on diamond painting kits. The kit is likely classified as a set under GRI 3(b). The essential character is probably the printed board, but the choices are several. Possible headings: 9503 (toys, such as a craft kit), 4911 (printed pictures), 4421 or 4412 (wood articles), and 9701 (paintings).

I recall rulings treating diamond painting kits as "other toys" in 9503.00.00 (e.g., NY N301234). Many diamond painting kits were classified in 9503.00.0073 (Toys... other: other), but 9503.00.00 has been restructured. Current subheadings: 9503.00.00 with statistical suffixes such as 9503.00.0073 "Other toys; reduced-size models; puzzles; parts and accessories: Other." Since 2022, 9503.00.00 has been split into 9503.00.0071 (Toys representing animals or non-human creatures, stuffed), 9503.00.0073 (Other), and so on. I believe 9503.00.0073 stands. Alternatively, there is a ruling stating diamond painting kits are classified in 9503.00.0090 for "Other." But 9503.00.0073 is the one I'll go with.

Note that the glitter and MDF board point toward a craft kit, though the 3D Glitter version may be classified as a decorative item instead (e.g., 4414 or 4420). I'll stay with the toy classification, since a craft kit for children's amusement fits 9503.
